title: In Situ Training of Optical Neural Networks by Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23875v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optical neural networks promise fast, energy-efficient computing, but every device departs from its design and must be trained with the hardware. In situ training relies on an expert-built calibrated digital model of each device or on gradient-free trial and error. Coding agents, large language models that write and run programs, have shown an emergent ability to understand and edit the weights of digital neural networks. Here we introduce optics as code, a method in which a coding agent trains an optical neural network from measurements alone, through a harness that returns camera images of its probes and requires a hypothesis per request. We discovered that the agent forms a physical understanding of the optics and reparametrizes the network with interpretable optical elements tuned on the hardware. translated_title: 基于编码智能体的光学神经网络原位训练
translated_abstract: 光学神经网络有望实现快速、节能的计算，但每个器件都会偏离其设计值，因此必须结合硬件进行训练。原位训练依赖于专家为每个器件构建的校准数字模型，或者依赖无梯度的试错方法。编码智能体——即能够编写和运行程序的大型语言模型——已经展现出理解和编辑数字神经网络权重的涌现能力。在此，我们提出“光学即代码”方法，编码智能体仅凭测量数据即可训练光学神经网络，其通过一个框架实现：该框架返回其探测操作所对应的相机图像，并要求每次请求都附带一个假设。我们发现，该智能体形成了对光学的物理理解，并用可在硬件上调谐的、可解释的光学元件对网络进行了重新参数化。该方法在分类和图像编码任务中优于无梯度方法，接近通过校准模型进行反向传播的性能。
tldr: 提出“光学即代码”方法，让编码智能体仅凭相机测量图像就能原位训练光学神经网络，自主形成对光学的物理理解并用可解释光学元件重新参数化网络，性能优于无梯度方法。
en_tdlr: We introduce "optics as code," a method in which a coding agent trains optical neural networks in situ from camera measurements alone, forming physical understanding of the optics and outperforming gradient-free methods.
